<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — Exact 1.65.1 pin, e2e script, root playwright.config.ts with testDir e2e, chromium project, BASE_URL defaulting to localhost:PORT/3000, webServer `npm run dev -- --port` only when BASE_URL is unset. Lockfile is generated and approved as +46.
- A2: met — signInAsCoach/signInAsAthlete click 'Sign in as <name>' on /cloud/login/ until localStorage local-db currentUid matches the uid, then wait for the URL to leave /cloud/login. Ported, nothing imported from .rivetari.
- A3: unverified — Two specs match the card (coach /cloud/ then the Athletes heading and region; athlete 'Latest Total Breath Score' region). Passing depends on the post-PR e2e evidence run.
- A4: unverified — Playwright output folders are gitignored. Whether vitest excludes e2e/ depends on the unchanged vitest config. Lint and typecheck rely on the judge's deterministic run.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Nothing in the diff keeps vitest away from e2e/smoke.spec.ts `e2e/smoke.spec.ts:1` — If the vitest config doesn't already restrict include, add `exclude: [...configDefaults.exclude, "e2e/**"]` to vitest.config.*.
- A slow sign-in that navigates after the 3s poll turns the next retry click into a 30s throw `e2e/auth.ts:11` — Before re-clicking, check currentUid (or whether the URL has left /cloud/login) and break if sign-in already happened. Alternatively, wrap the click in the same deadline handling.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `package-lock.json` (generated)._

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Nothing in the diff keeps vitest away from e2e/smoke.spec.ts
suggestions.detail: Vitest's default include pattern matches e2e/smoke.spec.ts. The diff doesn't touch the vitest config, so A4 holds only if the existing config already narrows include or excludes e2e/. If it doesn't, vitest imports @playwright/test's test() outside the Playwright runner and `npm test` fails. The vitest config isn't shown, so I can't confirm the failure; the judge's deterministic `npm test` run settles it.
suggestions.repro: On a clean clone with the default vitest include, run `npm test`. Vitest collects e2e/smoke.spec.ts and fails with 'Playwright Test did not expect test() to be called here'.
suggestions.fix: If the vitest config doesn't already restrict include, add `exclude: [...configDefaults.exclude, "e2e/**"]` to vitest.config.*.

suggestions.title: A slow sign-in that navigates after the 3s poll turns the next retry click into a 30s throw
suggestions.detail: If a click works but currentUid is written more than 3s later, the loop clicks again. By then the app may have navigated off /cloud/login, so the button is gone. card.click then times out after 30s and throws a generic locator error, which skips both the deadline message and the success path. This only affects test flakiness, not the app.
suggestions.repro: Sign-in that takes about 4s to persist currentUid and then redirects: the second iteration's click waits 30s for a button that no longer exists and throws.
suggestions.fix: Before re-clicking, check currentUid (or whether the URL has left /cloud/login) and break if sign-in already happened. Alternatively, wrap the click in the same deadline handling.
